properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 11 at 4:27PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 427 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a line of strong
thunderstorms extending from near Mead to over Broomfield, or
extending from 15 miles southwest of Greeley to 15 miles north of
Denver, moving east at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Thornton, northeastern Westminster, northeastern Broomfield,
northern Commerce City, northern Northglenn, Brighton, Firestone,
Frederick, Fort Lupton, Dacono, Platteville, Gilcrest, Todd Creek,
Barr Lake, Wattenburg, Henderson and Fort St Vrain.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 11 at 4:10PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Boulder, Longmont, Lafayette, Louisville, Erie, Johnstown,
Frederick, Berthoud, Dacono, Mead, Lyons, Niwot, Carter Lake,
Hygiene and Campion.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 11 at 3:25PM MDT until August 11 at 6:15PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding and debris flows are possible, flooding
caused by excessive rainfall is possible over the Gold Mountain
Burn Scar.

* WHERE...Gold Mountain Burn Scar in Ouray County including Dexter
and Cutler Creek drainages and Highway 550.

* WHEN...Until 615 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Excessive rainfall is possible over the Gold Mountain
Burn Scar which could lead to flash flooding and/or debris flows,
particularly along highway 550 between Cutler Creek and Dexter
Creek. The debris flow can consist of rock, mud, vegetation and
other loose materials.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 325 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms beginning to
develop over or near the Gold Mountain Burn Scar. Be prepared to
take action if stronger storms develop.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Gold Mountain Burn Scar between Ouray and Portland including
Dexter and Cutler Creeks
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
